_comment: intro = story cards shown once per session after ENTER THE MANOR (click/Space advances, Esc skips). lines = subtitle conversations keyed by event; each plays at most once per run and never pauses play. A line is [speaker, text]. Speaker colours live in speakers; display names in names (gothic capitals are hard to read, so use title case).
intro:
Blackglass Manor. Midnight.

At dawn Lord Veyr sails for the coast, and his ledger sails with him: every name he ever sold.

Yours was one of them.

They buried you in the dark. You came back as part of it.

Slip into any shadow close by. Even a guard's.
Put out the study lamp. Reach Veyr.

One strike. No witnesses.

mission_start: The kitchen garden. Servants come and go all night, and their shadows go wherever I need.
hall: Steward wants the silver crated before dawn. All of it.
Then the steward can carry it himself.
courtyard: The gatekeeper holds the only key. I don't need the key. I need his shadow.
first_ride: He doesn't feel a thing. They never do.
gallery: Third night on watch. His lordship's packing like the house is on fire.
Keep your voice down. And keep your eyes on the dark.
first_kill: One carrier fewer. Someone will find him soon.
key: His key. Louder than a shadow, but it opens the gate.
lights_off: Who put out the lamp? Bring a candle. Now.
study: Every name in that ledger paid for this house. Let them come and read it.
alarm: A body! Get his lordship to the carriage!
